descFields.name: Title
descFields.nameTooltip: Title of exhibition displayed when viewing the exhibition.
descFields.nameChapterTooltip: Title of chapter displayed in the center of the screen and in the list of chapters when browsing the exhibition.
descFields.nameScreenTooltip: Title of screen displayed to the visitor in the text bar. The title will also appear as the name of the screens in the list of all screens in the project. If not filled, the screen will remain listed as the type of the screen.
descFields.subnameTooltip: Optional addendum or subtitle to the title of the exhibition.
descFields.subnameChapterToolip: Additional or explanatory title of the chapter displayed under the main title in the middle of the screen.
descFields.perexTooltip: Text introducing the exhibition after clicking the 'More information' button on the start screen. It is displayed before the exhibition starts.
descFields.charCount: characters, estimated length of the commentary:
descFields.backgroundImageTooltip: An image from the document library that will be displayed in the background of the opening screen of the exhibition. The image can be enhanced with motion animation.
descFields.imageAnimationTooltip: Select the type of background image animation or choose no animation.
descFields.expoAudioTooltip: Link to the audio file, which contains the commentary of the entire exhibition. The visitor can download the complete commentary of the exhibition on the opening page of the exhibition.
descFields.audioScreenTrackTooltip: Upload background music or an audio version of the commentary here, or a commentary combined with music for this screen. The visitor can turn off the sound while viewing the exhibition.
descFields.audioChapterTrackTooltip: Upload background music to be played in a loop while viewing all screens in this chapter.
descFields.musicDescriptionHelpTooltip: Upload background music here that will be played in a loop while viewing all screens of this chapter.
descFields.expoSoundtrackTooltip: Upload an audio file, in .mp3 format, that will play in a loop while you navigate through the exhibition. Suitable for an exhibition that does not have chapters. This music can be turned off for selected screens.
descFields.expoSoundtrackDeleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete the exhibition soundtrack?
descFields.expoDurationTooltip: Estimated duration of the exhibition to inform the visitor.
descFields.screenTimeTooltip: It is not possible to set the screen time manually on this screen type, it is automatically calculated based on the settings in the Sequence section.
descFields.manualScreenTime: Manually set the time for each photo
descFields.organizationTooltip: The institution that created the exhibition.
descFields.textTooltip:
Addional text providing information to the visitor.

To format the text (font styles, bullets, etc.), use the individual options in the editor menu. After selecting the text, you can also select the font size and reduce or enlarge it. For Czech quotation marks, select the relevant passage and click on the quotation marks.
descFields.gameNameTooltip: Title of screen displayed to the visitor in the text bar. The title will also appear as the name of the screens in the list of all screens in the project. If not filled, the screen will remain listed as the type of the screen.
descFields.gameResultTimeTooltip: The number of seconds that determines how long the user will see the result of the game.
descFields.screenBackgroundColorTooltip: Here you can change the screen background color to better match the image background, or to visually distinguish game and interactive screens from static ones. However, we strongly recommend using color changes sparingly to maintain the elegant design of the entire exhibition!

startScreen.deleteImageConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the selected image?

introScreen.imageBoxTooltip: An image from the document library that will be displayed in the background of the chapter home screen. The image can be enhanced by a motion animation.
introScreen.imageAnimationTooltip: Choose from several types of background image animation.
introScreen.imageAnimationWithoutNoCrop: No animation and no image cropping

imageScreen.imageBoxTooltip: An image from the document library that will be displayed in the background of the chapter home screen. The image can be enhanced by a motion animation.
imageScreen.imageAnimationTooltip: Choose from several types of background image animation.

videoScreen.videoBoxTooltip: Upload a video from your computer or select from uploaded files.

textScreen.textTooltip: The text content of the screen that will be displayed to the user in the center of the screen. Maximum length is 300 characters including spaces. The font size is adjusted automatically according to the length of the text.

parallaxScreen.theLowestImageTooltip: The bottommost layer of the image. Represents the objects furthest from the viewer. It is animated at the slowest pace.
parallaxScreen.theTopmostImageTooltip: The very top layer of the image. It represents the closest objects to the viewer. It is animated at the fastest pace.
parallaxScreen.imageBoxTooltip: An image representing the selected layer. Each layer is represented by one image.
parallaxScreen.parallaxAnimationLabelTooltip: An image representing the selected layer. Each layer is represented by one image.

imageZoomScreen.zoomPositionTooltip: Zoom description position in presentation mode.
imageZoomScreen.seqDelayTooltip: The time that elapses before a new sequence starts after the previous one has ended.
imageZoomScreen.imageBoxTooltip: Main image being zoomed over. In the zoom sequence table, you can add a new zoom point and place it on the image. In the table, select the zoom level and animation duration for this point of interest.
imageZoomScreen.zoomTypeTooltip: Choose one of the available zoom animation options. If you want the zoom to smoothly transition from one point to another without returning to the full view, select the continuous zoom option.
imageZoomScreen.zoomTypeResetAfterZoomOption: Zoom with return to full view
imageZoomScreen.zoomTypeContinuousZoomOption: Continuous zoom without return to full view
imageZoomScreen.missingTextForSequence: There is no text associated with this sequence.

slideshowScreen.imageTransitionTooltip: The type of transition between individual images.
slideshowScreen.actualImageTimeTooltip: After this time has passed, the current image will move to the next one, or to the next screen if the current frame is the last in the sequence.
slideshowScreen.imageTransitionFlyInOutAndBlurBackground: From left to right with blurry background

photogalleryScreen.photoTitleTooltip: Image title, maximum name length 50 characters including spaces

imageChangeScreen.imageBeforeTooltip: Select the 'before' image from the document library. Attention, both images must be the same size to display correctly.
imageChangeScreen.imageAfterTooltip: Select the 'after' image from the document library. Attention, both images must be the same size to display correctly.
imageChangeScreen.animationTypeTooltip: Choose one of the image transition options.
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionLabel: The initial position of the slider on the screen
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionTooltip: Choose one of the five options where the slider will initially be placed on the screen.
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionStartOption: At the beginning of the screen
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionQuarterOption: In a quarter of the screen
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionHalfOption: In the middle of the screen
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionThreeQuarterOption: In three quarters of the screen
imageChangeScreen.initialRodPositionEndOption: At the end of the screen
imageChangeScreen.initialGradualTransitionPositionLabel: The starting position of the gradual transition
imageChangeScreen.initialGradualTransitionPositionTooltip: Choose one of the three options from where the gradual transition will start.

externalScreen.insertedCodeTooltip: Here, insert the embed code of the website or service you want to include in the exhibition.

signpostScreen.headerTooltip: The text that appears as the title of this screen
signpostScreen.subheaderTooltip: The text that appears as the subtitle of this screen

deleteLinkDialog.textErrLessThanOne: The minimum number of allowed responses has been reached, that is one.
deleteLinkDialog.textConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this reference? The action is non-refundable!

signpostScreen.linkNotSufficientlyFilled: This reference is not filled in enough, so it will be ignored in the exhibition!

timelineScreen.nameFieldTooltip: Enter a name for the timeline, e.g. '20th Century Birth Rate', so visitors know what they are looking at
timelineScreen.typeSelectFieldTooltip: Select the basic timeline type that best fits your topic, and its slope and length
timelineScreen.timelineBoxTooltip: Add points to the timeline and place them as needed. Choose from different types – image, text, video.
timelineScreen.evenDistributionOfPointsBtnLabel: Evenly distribute points on the timeline
timelineScreen.timelineColorTooltip: Choose any color for your timeline that will be visible to visitors.
timelineScreen.timelineThicknessTooltip: Select the thickness for your timeline. The minimum allowed value is 1 and the maximum allowed value is 25.
timelineScreen.noBackgroundImage: No image has been selected yet
timelineScreen.bgImageTransparencyLabel: Transparency of the selected background image
timelineScreen.bgImageTransparencyTooltip: Set the transparency level for your background image. The minimum allowed value is 1, and the maximum allowed value is 100.
timelineScreen.leftBoundaryTooltip: Select one of the available options for the left boundary, the start of the timeline. The default value is a dot.
timelineScreen.rightBoundaryTooltip: Select one of the available options for the right boundary, the end of the timeline. The default value is an arrow.

surveyScreen.nameTooltip: The name of the screen that will be displayed to visitors in the text version bar. The name will also appear as the label of screens in the list of all screens during editing. If you don’t fill it in, the screen type name will remain displayed in the list.
surveyScreen.taskTooltip: Describe the topic of the survey and what participants should reflect on. You can also write a few sentences for clarification.
surveyScreen.surveyTypeLabel: Select the form of the survey
surveyScreen.surveyShouldDisplayAnswerFeedbackCheckbo: Choose whether to show feedback to the visitor
surveyScreen.answerImageTooltip: Select an illustrative image from the document library.
surveyScreen.answerTextTooltip: Enter an appropriately long text for this answer option. We recommend a maximum of 120–160 characters.

deleteAnswerDialog.textErrorLessThanThree: The minimum allowed number of answers has been reached — three.
deleteAnswerDialog.textConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this option? This action cannot be undone!

finishScreen.deleteImageConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the selected image?

gameFindScreen.taskTooltip: Describe this task to the user as precisely as possible (e.g. find on the map where the Church of the Holy Cross stood).
gameFindScreen.imageAssignmentTooltip: From the document library, select an image on which the user will search for a specific point based on the input.
gameFindScreen.imageResultTooltip: Select an image from the document library that shows the correct location that the user should have found.
gameFindScreen.showUsersTipTooltip: Check this box if you want the user to see both the correct solution and their guess.
gameFindScreen.numberOfPinsTooltip: Enter the number of points you want the visitor to find. Each point will then be able to have its own unique text assigned.

gameDrawScreen.taskTooltip: Describe the user's task as precisely as possible (e.g. complete the graph of how coal mining developed after 1950).
gameDrawScreen.imageAssignmentTooltip: Select an image from the document library, part of which will be missing and the user should draw it.
gameDrawScreen.imageResultTooltip: Select a complete image from the document library.
gameDrawScreen.showUsersDrawingTooltip: Check this box if you want the user to see both the correct solution and their guess.
gameDrawScreen.assignmentInfopointsTableTooltip: Using infopoints and the information in them, you can direct the visitor to think more deeply about the result.

gameWipeScreen.taskTooltip: Describe the user's task as precisely as possible (e.g. see how the building looked before its renovation).
gameWipeScreen.upperImageTooltip: Select the top image showing the 'before' phase from the document library.
gameWipeScreen.bottomImageTooltip: From the document library, select the image that appears after erasing the top image to show the 'after' stage.

gameSizingScreen.taskTooltip: Describe the task to the user as precisely as possible (e.g. Estimate how big the Venus from Vestonice statuette is compared to the matchbox).
gameSizingScreen.imageReferenceTooltip: Select an image of the object to be guessed from the document library, and have visitors compare the size of the image to the second image.
gameSizingScreen.imageCompareTooltip: From the document library, select an image of the second object to compare.
gameSizingScreen.imageResultTooltip: From the document library, select a pre-prepared image that clearly shows the size of both objects. Use the option to add infopoints to comment on the relationship between objects.

gameMoveScreen.taskTooltip: Describe the user's task as precisely as possible (e.g., select the correct shard and assemble the broken plate).
gameMoveScreen.imageAssignmentTooltip: Select a pre-made image from the document library where a certain part is missing.
gameMoveScreen.imageResultTooltip: Select the complete image from the document library.
gameMoveScreen.objectTooltip: From the document library, select an image with parts for the user to select from.
gameMoveScreen.screenPreviewTooltip: Drag objects to selected locations, from which the visitor is tasked with placing the objects on the background image. You can also use the arrow to move or enlarge the object.

gameQuizScreen.nameTooltip: Title of screen displayed to the visitor in the text bar. The title will also appear as the name of the screens in the list of all screens in the project. If not filled, the screen will remain listed as the type of the screen.
gameQuizScreen.taskTooltip: A question that the visitor has to answer by choosing from 3 options.
gameQuizScreen.answerDisplayTypeLabel: Choose when to display the reply text
gameQuizScreen.answerDisplayTypeAfterEvaluationOption: Show only after the quiz is evaluated
gameQuizScreen.correctAnswerTooltip: If this answer is correct, mark it.
gameQuizScreen.answerImageTooltip: Select an image from the document library.
gameQuizScreen.answerTextTooltip: Please enter a reasonably long text for this answer option. We recommend a maximum of 120-160 characters.

deleteAnswerDialog.titleErrorLessThanThree: It is not possible to delete more options!
deleteAnswerDialog.textErrorLessThanThree: The minimum number of allowed answers was reached, namely three.
deleteAnswerDialog.textConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this option? The action is non-refundable!

documentsTable.startScreenTableTooltip: Documents and files for the exhibition that will be displayed on the opening and closing screens.

imprintTable.imprintTooltip: A circulation item. Usually a person and their role in the project or other accompanying text.

footer.screenSaveErrText: The screen could not be saved!
footer.ednActionsText: Finish all ongoing actions before opening the screen preview!
